भिद् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (भिंदति) To divide
or cut into parts. {vII.v} {c7c} U. (
भिनत्ति, भिंत्ते, बिभेद, बिभिदे, अभैत्सीत्, अभिदत्,
अभित्त, भेत्स्यति-ते, भेत्तुं, भिन्न)
1 To break,
cleave, split, cut asunder, rend,
pierce, break through or down;
अतिशीतलमप्यंभः किं भिनत्ति न भूभृतः

; तेषां कथं नु हृदयं न भिनत्ति
लज्जा

.
--5 To violate, transgress, break,
infringe; समयं लक्ष्मणोऽभिनत्

.
--6 To
[]
remove, take away; Śi. 15. 87.
--7
To disturb, interrupt; as in
समाधिभेदिन्.
--8 To change, alter; (न)
भिंदंति मंदां गतिमश्वपुख्यः

; or
विश्वासोपगमादभिम्नगतयः शब्दं सहंते
मृगाः Ś. 1. 14.
--9 To expand, cause
to open or blossom, open;
सूर्यांशुभिर्भिन्नमिवारविंदं

.
--12 To loosen, relax,
dissolve; पर्यंकबंधं निबिडं बिभेद

.
--13 To disclose, divulge.
--14
To perplex, distract.
--15 To
distinguish, discriminate. --Pass.
(भिद्यते)
1 To be split, rent or
shivered;

.
--2 To be divided or separated.
--3
To expand, blossom, open.
--4 To
be loose or relaxed; प्रस्थानभिन्नां न
बबंध नीविं

.
--6 To be destroyed.
--7 To
be divulged or betrayed, get abroad;
षट्कर्णो भिद्यते मंत्रः &c.

.
--8 To be harassed, pained or
afflicted.
--9 To be frightened or
alarmed;

.
--10 To
separate oneself from, keep aloof from.
--Caus. (भेदयति-ते)
1 To split,
cleave, divide, tear &c.
--2 To
destroy, dissolve.
--3 To disunite, set
at variance.
--4 To perplex.
--5 To
seduce. --Desid. (बिभित्सति-ते) To
wish to break &c.

भिद् a. (At the end of comp.)
Breaking, splitting; destroying &c.
[]
--f.
1 Breaking, splitting, dividing.
--2 Difference.
--3 A sort, kind.

भिदकः [भिद् --क्वुन्] A sword.
--कं
1 A diamond.
--2 Indra's
thunderbolt.

भिदा [भिद्-भावे अङ्]
1
Breaking, bursting, rending, tearing;
Śi. 6. 5.
--2 Separation.
--3
Difference.
--4 Kind, species, sort.
--5
Coriander.

भिदुर a. [भिद्-कुरच्]
1 Breaking,
bursting, splitting.
--2 Fragile,
brittle.
--3 Blended, variegated,
mixed, mingled;
नलिश्मद्युतिभिदुरांभसोऽपरत्र Śi. 4. 26; 19. 58, 20. 1.
--रः The Plakṣa tree.
--रं A
thunderbolt.

1 A rushing river.
--2 N. of a
particular river; तोयदागम
इवोद्ध्यमिद्ययोर्नामधेयसदृशं विचेष्टितं
